Pending security.authorization claims are not treated as trusted eligibility evidence or as a requirement introduced merely by this queue change. A distinct active project reviewer satisfies the supplied earlier review prerequisite without requiring execution claims. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree; the provenance explains the different manifest/evaluation digest domains and original/saved PRD normalization. The original specification's remaining-preparation fields are distinguishable from the subsequently supplied frozen preview. Historical project reuse and retained old-version operations do not establish candidate execution on this bundle, and no historical candidate outputs were used. This approval relies on the supplied Service-bound fingerprints and provenance, not independent digest recomputation, code execution, test results, or a new human attestation.
